<!--
Pull requests target `dev`, not `main`. Only `dev` merges into `main`.
Branch name: `<type>/<short-description>`, for example `fix/mysql-schedule-retire`
(types: feat, fix, docs, test, refactor, perf, chore, release/<version>).
-->

## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? Link related issues with "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new capability
- [ ] `fix`: bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `test`: tests only
- [ ] `refactor`: no behaviour change
- [ ] `perf`: performance
- [ ] `chore`: tooling, dependencies, repository housekeeping
- [ ] `release`: release preparation

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run verify:docs` passes (documentation changes)
- [ ] Specification or docs under `docs/` updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased` for user-visible changes
